attributes.title: AAHFN Annual Meeting 2027
attributes.organizer: American Association of Heart Failure Nurses
attributes.summary:
The American Association of Heart Failure Nurses meets in Boston, Massachusetts, for its 2027 Annual Meeting, listed on the official call for papers as June 23 to 25, 2027. The meeting is for nurses and advanced practice clinicians who manage patients with heart failure in hospitals, clinics and home care.

AAHFN is collecting abstracts in three tracks. Best Practices submissions close November 30, 2026, and Research and Quality Improvement submissions close December 15, 2026. Registration fees, the venue and contact hours had not been published when we checked.
